judiciary_art4section5tracker.amendment_: Hindise sharci wax-ka-beddel ah oo guddi jooga →
judiciary_art4section5tracker.due_within: waa in lagu soo gudbiyo {timeframe_days} maalmood gudahood marka go'aanka maxkamadda soo baxo · {remedy} · Art. IV §5 — ra'yiyadu waxay ahaanayaan faallo ku saabsan sharciga sida wax-ka-beddelka looga sameeyay
judiciary_art4section5tracker.enforcemen: Fulintu waxay raacaysaa xaaladda ugu dambeysa ee sharciga: wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyay, lagu taageeray burinta diidmada, ama maxkamaddu wax-ka-beddel ku sameysay. Tallaabooyinka fulinta
judiciary_art4section5tracker.executives: Fulintu waxay fulisaa natiijada — waddo kasta oo lagu xalliyo
judiciary_art4section5tracker.filed_by_a: La gudbiyay: {filed_at} waxaa gudbiyay {filed_by_label} — qof kasta oo deganaa waa gudbin karaa; ma jirto cid xannibta marka laga reebo xiriirka xuduud awoodeedka.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.finding_re: Go'aanka maxkamadda & sixid garsoor lagu taliyay
judiciary_art4section5tracker.if_the_win: Haddii muddadu xirmo iyadoo aan wax-ka-beddel ama burinta diidmadu dhicin, garsoorku wuxuu sixid garsoorka si toos ah ugu dabaqayaa qoraalka sharciga. Taariikhda noocyada waa la kaydinayaa.

judiciary_art4section5tracker.no_constit: Ma jirto caabasho dastuuriga ah oo furan xuduudaha awoodeedkaaga
judiciary_art4section5tracker.opinions_r: ra'yiyadu waxay ahaanayaan faallo ku saabsan sharciga sida uu u qoran yahay ama loo beddelay · Art. IV §5
judiciary_art4section5tracker.override_v: Burinta diidmada — codadka taageeraya dhammaan xubnaha shaqaynaya
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_a_leg: Waddada A — Golaha sharci-dejinta ayaa wax-ka-beddelaya ama saaraya
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_b_sup: Waddada B — Burinta diidmada ee aqlabiyad gaar ah muddada diidmada dhexdeeda
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_c_win: Waddada C — Muddadu way xirmanaysaa, garsoorkuna wuxuu wax-ka-beddelayaa sharciga
judiciary_art4section5tracker.remedy_app: Sixid garsoor si toos ah loo dabaqay
judiciary_art4section5tracker.supermajor: Aqlabiyad gaar ah oo dhammaan xubnaha shaqaynaya — ma aha oo kaliya kuwa jooga — oo lagu diiwaangeliyay muddada diidmada dhexdeeda.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_law_st: Sharcigu wuxuu u taagan yahay sida uu u qoran yahay; go'aanka maxkamadda, codka burinta diidmada, iyo mowqifka xubin kasta waxay ku jiraan diiwaan dadweyne.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_legisl: Golaha sharci-dejintu wuxuu leeyahay {timeframe_days} maalmood si uu wax-ka-beddel ugu sameeyo ama u saaro sharciga (CLK-12, waqtiga ugu dambeeya {timeframe_due_on}) iyo {veto_window_days} maalmood si uu u buriyo diidmada ({remedy}).
Golaha sharci-dejintu wuxuu wax-ka-beddelayaa ama saarayaa sharciga isagoo maraya hannaanka caadiga ah ee hindise sharci muddada garsoorka dhexdeeda.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_three_: Saddexda waddo ee xallinta Art. IV §5
judiciary_art4section5tracker.when_a_cou: Marka maxkamaddu soo saarto go'aan hoos yimaada Art. IV §5, raadiyahan wuxuu tusayaa go'aanka, sixid garsoorka lagu taliyay, labada saacadood (CLK-11 / CLK-12), iyo saddexda waddo ee xallinta ee tooska ah.
judiciary_caselifecycle.back_and_advance: Dib u noqoshada iyo Horay u socodka waxay u dhaqaaqaan taxanaha — waa simulation kaliya.
judiciary_jurorscreening.a_panel_judge_f: Garsoore guddiga ah ayaa dib u eegaya jawaabaha aad calaamadsay. Haddii lagu xaqiijiyo iska horimaad danta ah, waxaa laguu fasaxayaa adigoon ganaax lagu soo rogay, waxaana lagu beddelayaa qof kale oo lagu soo xulay si nasiib ah.
judiciary_jurorscreening.answer_honestly: Si daacad ah uga jawaab — baaritaanka waxaa looga saaraa iska horimaadka danta, marna laguma soo saaro ra'yiga, astaamaha dadka, ama siyaasadda. Jawaabahaaga waxaa heli kara oo kaliya garsooreyaasha guddiga.
judiciary_jurorscreening.flagged_for_voi: Waa lagu calaamadeeyay dib-u-eegista voir dire
judiciary_jurorscreening.no_conflicts_de: Ma jiraan iska horimaadyo la sheegay
judiciary_jurorscreening.you_remain_in_t: Waxaad ku jirtaa kaydka guddiga. Xulashada guddiga waxaa lagu xaqiijinayaa voir dire.
judiciary_paneltable.panel_assignment_an: Natiijooyinka xilka guddiga iyo baaritaanka iska horimaadka danta
